sinopsis.es: Chris Evert y Martina Navratilova narran su historia entrelazada como rivales en el tenis y como amigas que enfrentan sus propias batallas contra el cáncer, reexaminando décadas de competición.
sinopsis.en: Chris Evert and Martina Navratilova narrate their intertwined histories as tennis rivals and as friends now facing their own battles with cancer — reexamining decades of competition through the lens of mortality.
